title: While main is red, the fixing item merges first and the others wait for a green base
description: Runs the real merge writer cycle with a base failure recorded on main and main moved on still red: the filed base repair and the master's hotfix are trialled and merge, the unrelated item starts no trial and is shown waiting for a green base, and it merges once main carries the fix (GY-3451).

steps.name: the fix merges first; the other item waits for a green main, then merges
